comments.author: V_I
comments.body: Funny thing, there is actually a discovery light from Observe, but it's almost impossible to see: it's straight up in the air, directly above a hill, and only visible from the area due west from the Diagonal Boulder, before you head north to the crossroads. I saw it completely by accident on my way to where your directions said to go, and thanks for posting them by the way.
